description: Nouvelle-Aquitaine : TRI d'Arcachon (aléa ) - Données géolocalisées pour le SIG" Directive inondation" du territoire à risque d'inondation d'Arcachon is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Le géostandard Directive inondation décrit le socle des données géographiques produites sur les territoires à risque important d’inondation (TRI) et cartographiées aux fins de rapportage pour la directive européenne sur les inondations. Coverage: FR. Its keywords include inondation, risque, directive inondation, surfaces inondables, Arcachon, tri. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
